title: Expose lifecycle qualification through the installed CLI
requires: Any development host plus one production driver implementing both adverse lifecycle fixtures
scope: Make the adverse-capacity-three-family-v1 producer a first-class mode of the installed parallel-mater-conformance executable, using the same fixture and serialization path as embedded platform qualification.
acceptance: Add an explicit lifecycle CLI mode that writes the complete profile result, reports malformed arguments clearly and preserves explicit unsupported or failed fixture outcomes.
Build the capacity, graph and resource lifecycle producers for desktop conformance without copying their checkpoint assembly or coupling the command to iOS-only quality fixtures.
Prove the build-tree and installed CLI outputs pass conformance/v1/lifecycle.py on every production driver available on the host, and document the installed invocation.
